inputs: POST /play_audio: raw PCM (Content-Type audio/L16; rate=4000..192000; channels=1 or 2; s16le) or Ogg Opus
plugins: unix socket audio.player, at most 2048 bytes per write
path.buffer: 262144-byte clip ring, taken out in 640-byte packets and resampled to 8 kHz mono (0x9fb7c)
path.output: every input ends in sdk_speaker_write (0x77f8c) -> HI_MPI_ADEC_SendStream (LPCM, blocking) -> ADEC channel 0 bound to AO device 0 channel 0 at 8000 Hz; the stock cmsMain.out runs the AO at 44100 Hz
path.init_audio_out: HI_MPI_ADEC_CreateChn (always PT_LPCM = 23) -> AO start -> bind -> speakerPin -> amplifier
path.amplifier: GPIO63, active high (speakerPinInvert false); majestic sets it to 1 when sound starts and back to 0 after speakerPinHoldMs (default 2000 ms) without sound
path.verdict: correct: the played sound has the right pitch, length and order, with low distortion

defaults.audio.speakerPin: not set: the amplifier stays off and nothing is heard

problems: audio.speakerPin is not set by default, so the speaker stays silent even with audio.outputEnabled true; easy/post_setup.py (VERSION 3) now sets it to 63 as a board key

audio.outputVolume changed nothing: majestic has no live speaker level for this vendor (a change only rebuilds the audio) and HI_MPI_AO_SetVolume returns 0xA0168008 (HI_ERR_AO_NOT_SUPPORT) in this SDK; the stock cmsMain.out scales the samples itself, (v - 50) * 0.6 dB
findings.acoustics: 500 Hz makes the housing rattle (everything else is 5 dB above the fundamental); 2 kHz comes out about 13 dB weaker than 1 kHz; this is the speaker and housing, not the processing

fix.library: audio/libmajaudiofix.so from audio/majaudiofix.S (GNU as/ld 2.40, against the musl libc.so of the rootfs); exports HI_MPI_AI_SetPubAttr (microphone, logic unchanged), HI_MPI_ADEC_CreateChn and HI_MPI_ADEC_SendStream; imports dlsym and syslog
fix.create_chn: after the real call succeeded for PT_LPCM: audio.outputVolume through majestic's config_get_int (dlsym RTLD_DEFAULT), not set -> 50, clamped to 0..100; Q16 gain 0 for 0, else round(65536 * 10^((v - 50) * 0.03)); syslog 'majaudiofix: speaker outputVolume %d -> gain %d/65536'; another type or no config_get_int -> 65536; a failed call keeps the previous gain
fix.send_stream: gain 65536: passed through untouched; else the samples are copied to the stack as (s * gain + 0x8000) >> 16, saturated to 16 bits, and libmpi gets a copy of the AUDIO_STREAM_S that points at them; the caller's struct and buffer are only read; empty, NULL or more than 8192 bytes: passed through; an odd last byte is copied as it is
fix.live: majestic rebuilds the audio output (HI_MPI_ADEC_CreateChn) whenever the audio settings change, so cli -s .audio.outputVolume N takes effect at once in the same process

verification.method: 8 kHz mono s16le tones POSTed to /play_audio and recorded back with the camera's own microphone (/audio.pcm); daytime, 1 to 4.5 s, quiet

path.amplifier_gpio63: 1 only while playing, back to 0 about 2 s after the sound
path.adec: SendCnt 25 per 1 s clip (640 bytes each), SendFail 0
